name: ForeRunners Organization
tagline: Empowering Youth. Strengthening Communities. Creating Change.
vision: A resilient, empowered and inclusive society where young people, women and vulnerable groups have access to opportunities, dignity, well-being and sustainable livelihoods.
mission: To empower youth, women and vulnerable communities through capacity building, mental well-being support, livelihoods, digital literacy and community-led initiatives.
strategicObjectives: Strengthen youth and women's leadership and participation
Increase access to safe, inclusive mental health and psychosocial support
Improve digital literacy, online safety and well-being
Promote environmental awareness, climate adaptation and green livelihoods
Improve governance, safeguarding and evidence-based learning
